room.hall.title: Hall of Locks
room.hall.description: Three iron levers, [A](lever_a), [B](lever_b) and [C](lever_c), jut from the north wall beside a heavy door. By the east door sit three brass dial wheels: [first](wheel_1), [second](wheel_2), [third](wheel_3).
room.lever_vault.title: Lever Vault
room.lever_vault.description: A small vault behind the lever door.
room.dial_vault.title: Dial Vault
room.dial_vault.description: A small vault behind the dial door.
detail.wheel_1: A brass wheel marked 0 to 9, the first of three.
detail.wheel_2: A brass wheel marked 0 to 9, the second of three.
detail.wheel_3: A brass wheel marked 0 to 9, the third of three.
narration.lever: The lever clanks down and springs back.
narration.wheel: The wheel clicks round one notch.
